company.name: Salient
company.shortDescription: Salient is an AI-driven loan servicing platform built specifically for consumer finance and auto lending industries.
company.description: Salient is an AI-driven loan servicing platform designed primarily for consumer finance and auto lending industries. It uses AI agents to automate borrower interactions via voice, text, email, and web chat. These agents handle tasks such as payment collection, due date changes, extensions, payoffs, insurance updates, and general customer queries in real-time. Salient is built with compliance at its core, ensuring adherence to key lending regulations like CFPB, FCRA, TILA, UDAAP, and TCPA with real-time monitoring and fraud detection features.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $60,000,000, or 99.17% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,111,903 to $350,000,000, a 26.69x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
